lines.trans: Come on, it is time to go.
Tell me, is this the movie?
Where Depardieu got totally drunk?
To get out of his character?
Yes, that is exactly it.
Can I borrow it from you?
Of course, go ahead.
If there are others that interest you...
Take everything, it is for you.
You know what?
Just put together a selection for me.
If you want, no problem.
I have everything needed in Paris.
But we do not have the same tastes!
Exactly, that is perfect.

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?

examples.text: Il y a une autre Clémentine?
L'un à midi, l'autre à deux heures.
examples.trans: One at noon, the other at two.

examples.text: Il y a un macaron sur la table.
examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

meanings.note: elle a quarante ans = she is forty

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are

examples.text: Bien sûr que tu es fatiguée.

meanings.note: bien sûr que + sentence = of course...
before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel

meanings.en: drunken state, binge (prendre une cuite = get hammered)

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.

meanings.note: dire la vérité à quelqu'un = to tell someone the truth

examples.trans: Can I borrow it from you?

meanings.note: preposition: en vacances, en huit ans
pronoun before the verb: j'en ai assez, je n'en peux plus
also as an answer: Exactement! = That's right!
pour faire quoi? = to do what?
faire du vélo = to ride a bike, to cycle

falloir.governs: il faut + infinitive, or il faut que + subjunctive

meanings.note: only with the impersonal 'il': il faut
il me faut un stylo = I need a pen
avoir quel goût? = to taste like what?
quelle heure est-il? = what time is it?
à tout à l'heure = see you later

examples.trans: This part interests me a lot.

meanings.en: s'intéresser à = to be interested in

examples.trans: I was just thinking of you.

meanings.note: before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà

examples.text: Je veux, mais je ne peux pas.
examples.trans: I want to, but I can't.

meanings.note: object pronoun before the verb: tu me donnes
with reflexive verbs: je me débrouille
before the noun: le même lifting
as an adverb: même Andréa = even Andréa
ne ... pas: not; ne ... plus: not anymore; ne ... jamais: never
everyday speech, with a he/she verb form

meanings.en: pas du tout: not at all

examples.text: Je suis là pour voir Mathias.

examples.trans: I can't take it any more.

meanings.note: je peux t'appeler? = may I call you?
je n'en peux plus = I can't take any more

examples.text: Dis-lui que je ne peux pas venir.

examples.trans: I'm the one who trained you!

meanings.note: c'est moi qui... = I'm the one who...
alone, in surprise or when you didn't hear; a bit blunt

meanings.en: part, role (in a film or play)

examples.trans: Do you know where he is?

savoir.gloss: to know; to know how to

meanings.note: je ne sais pas = I don't know

examples.text: Si tu veux le rôle, tu dois changer.
examples.trans: If you want the part, you have to change.

meanings.note: agrees with the thing owned, not the owner

examples.text: Si Kadropov sort avec une belle femme comme toi, il le dit à tout le monde!
examples.trans: If Kadropov goes out with a beautiful woman like you, he tells everyone!

meanings.note: passé composé with 'être': elle est sortie

meanings.en: sortir avec quelqu'un = to go out with someone, to date

meanings.note: before the verb; t' before a vowel
used alone, after a preposition, or for emphasis: et toi?, avec toi, toi aussi

examples.text: Ça ne va pas du tout.

meanings.note: oui à tout = yes to everything
plural tous (pronounced 'tous' with s): merci à tous
before a noun: tout le monde = everyone
singular and informal: friends, family, children, colleagues of the same age

meanings.en: go ahead, go on (informal imperative phrase)

meanings.note: + noun: je veux un café; + infinitive: je veux partir
il y a = there is / there are
j'y pense = I think about it
place: à Paris, à mon cours

meanings.en: au = à + le, aux = à + les
